title: Make data-quality governance actionable
requirements:
- Make data-quality criteria use-case and risk specific
- Add a progress dimension measuring completeness, validity, timeliness and provenance of data at source
- Add a data-quality-assurance dimension naming who reviews data and how corrections propagate, including mixed paper/digital modes
- Name mechanisms by which contributors gain value from the data they enter
- Link it to 5.2's discussion of data-quality cascade
